## About
Techni-Quest is a family-owned auto repair shop serving Cary and the surrounding communities. We service and repair all makes and models of domestic and import vehicles, from routine oil changes to big jobs. We're small enough to know you by name and equipped to diagnose and repair today's complex vehicles.
Our customers come back year after year because they can count on our honesty, quality, and friendly service. One reviewer gives a shout-out to Tyler at the front desk, who takes the time to explain what we're doing and even turns his computer screen so she can see. Another says Josh is always patient and friendly when talking with them.
We're a NAPA AutoCare Center and the logical alternative to the dealership for your scheduled maintenance. Rated 4.9 from 134 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake Repair: Brake work done right so your car or truck is safe to drive.
- Oil Changes: Regular oil changes, along with tire rotations, inspections and other routine maintenance.
- General Maintenance: Regular preventative maintenance to keep your vehicle in top shape.
- Wheel Alignment: One reviewer understands we have one of the best alignment shops in Cary.
- A/C & Heat: Heating and air conditioning repair, including big jobs like replacing HVAC actuator motors behind the dash.
- Exhaust System: From the engine to the exhaust pipe, we work on all parts of the exhaust system.
- Diagnostics: State of the art technology and tools to find the problem on today's complex vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Will servicing my car here affect my manufacturer's warranty?
A: No. We're the logical alternative to the dealership for scheduled maintenance, and your car is serviced correctly while maintaining your manufacturer's warranty.

Q: Do you work on imports as well as domestic cars?
A: Yes. We service and repair all makes and models of domestic and import vehicles.

Q: Can I drop my car off before or after hours?
A: Yes. We have an Early Bird or Night Owl key drop.

Q: Will I know the price before you start?
A: Yes. As a NAPA AutoCare Center, we get your authorization and give you a price estimate before we do the work.
